scope: Federal Fair Housing advertising language risk screening; English; no legal certification

sources.note: Advertising preferences, limitations and discrimination; section 3604(c).
Limited older-person housing and religious-organization/private-club provisions; never inferred solely from a phrase.
Appendix reproduces historical 1995 HUD advertising guidance; explanatory context, not a substitute for current law.

rules.message: Excludes households with children.
rules.suggestion: Describe the property, not which households may live there.

rules.message: States that households with children are not accepted.
rules.suggestion: Remove household exclusions and describe objective property features.

rules.message: Advertises an adult-only or child-free occupancy restriction.
rules.suggestion: Remove the restriction or send documented older-person housing eligibility for qualified review.

rules.message: Discourages households with children from the dwelling.
rules.suggestion: Describe objective physical conditions without excluding households.

rules.message: Suggests a preferred household profile; review the intended meaning.
rules.suggestion: Replace the resident profile with concrete layout, space, or amenity details.

rules.message: Older-person housing eligibility cannot be verified from an advertisement alone.
rules.suggestion: Verify applicable program, occupancy, policies and age-verification requirements; text alone grants no exception.

rules.message: Excludes wheelchair users.
rules.suggestion: Remove the resident exclusion; describe verified accessibility features accurately.

rules.message: Excludes people because of disability.
rules.suggestion: Remove disability-based occupancy or applicant restrictions.

rules.message: Requires a physical ability profile for residents.
rules.suggestion: Describe the dwelling and access conditions without prescribing residents' abilities.

rules.message: Assistance-animal restrictions may require a disability accommodation review.
rules.suggestion: Send the policy for accommodation review; do not treat assistance animals as ordinary pets automatically.

rules.message: Describes physical access rather than excluding a group of residents.
rules.suggestion: Confirm the physical description is accurate; this language screen does not certify accessibility compliance.

rules.message: Expresses a racial or ethnic occupancy preference.
rules.suggestion: Remove the preference and describe property features instead.

rules.message: Explicitly excludes a racial or ethnic group.
rules.suggestion: Remove the group exclusion.

rules.message: States a preferred racial or ethnic group for residents.
rules.suggestion: Describe the home and remove resident-group preferences.

rules.message: Uses racial or ethnic composition as a housing description.
rules.suggestion: Review context and replace demographic descriptions with objective location features.

rules.message: Restricts or prefers residents based on skin color.
rules.suggestion: Remove skin-color preferences or exclusions.

rules.message: Excludes people based on national origin or an origin-related resident label.
rules.suggestion: Remove origin-based resident restrictions.

rules.message: Requires a resident birthplace or national-origin profile.
rules.suggestion: Remove birthplace-based resident requirements.

rules.message: States a preferred national origin for residents.
rules.suggestion: Remove national-origin preferences.

rules.message: Language or citizenship wording requires contextual and program-specific review.
rules.suggestion: Review the actual requirement and applicable law; do not infer illegality solely from this phrase.

rules.message: Excludes residents based on religion.
rules.suggestion: Remove the religious restriction or obtain review of a documented statutory exception.

rules.message: Expresses a religious preference for residents.
rules.suggestion: Remove the preference or send documented religious-organization housing facts for qualified review.

rules.message: Uses a religious community identity in a housing description.
rules.suggestion: Review context and describe objective property or location features.

rules.message: Expresses a sex-based resident restriction or preference.
rules.suggestion: Remove the resident restriction; shared-living or other exception claims require qualified review.

rules.message: Sex-specific roommate advertising requires shared-living and jurisdictional review.
rules.suggestion: Review actual shared-living facts and applicable law; a roommate keyword is not an automatic exemption.
